title: Rhenium Metal Powder
summary: The post Rhenium Metal Powder appeared first on Titan International, Inc. .
body_markdown: Economic Advantage: Titan is a US domestic supplier that consistently produces 99.99% pure Re metal powder from 100% recycled sources. Our hydrometallurgical system is capable of using various feeds and engineered for production of pure Rhenium. With intrinsic low gas content, Titan’s Re metal powder is available in a variety of mesh sizes either for spheroidizing or direct use. Tell us about your by products! By working together, Titan can help your process achieve economic sustainability.
